runs.platform: RunPod pod, secure H100 NVL US-GA-2 ($3.19/h)
runs.data: 5,754 rows under contract dd+notes+think@24576: 5,202 v6 rows re-answered by GLM 5.3 Flash under the thinking prompt and judge-agreed, plus 578 rows from the 210 questions v4 missed out of 644 freshly distilled; max_length 8192, batch 4 x 16
runs.costNote: 4.46 h wall at $3.19/h including export and Q8_0 quantize; the serverless endpoint had no GPU capacity so training moved to a pod
runs.notes: train_loss 0.5175; 174 s/step; LongMemEval paired on one pod against v4 (raw, 4/15/10, DeepSeek judge): 391/500 vs 381 and 203/266 vs 182. Per type on the 500: multi-session 85->93, temporal 99->104, knowledge-update 60->58, single-session-assistant 52->50. Best reader measured; serve it with --reading notes --reader-max-tokens 1024.

runs.platform: RunPod pod, secure H100 NVL US-GA-2 ($3.19/h)
runs.data: 5,748 rows under dd+notes+think@24576: v7 data with a quarter replaced by 1,438 rows built from the 466 questions v7 missed among 2,210 it had never seen (1,071 multi-session), each miss about three times
runs.costNote: $14.2 of training plus about $20 of idle pod time after TRAIN_DONE: the pod parks by design and the local watcher that should have stopped it was killed by memory pressure. Pods now stop themselves (pod.py self_stop, --max-hours, --idle-minutes).
runs.notes: train_loss 0.5012. Paired against v7 on one pod (raw, 4/15/10, DeepSeek judge, both thinking): 384/500 vs 391 and 194/266 vs 204. Multi-session, the type the data targeted, fell 93->87 on the 500 and 98->89 on the 266. Negative result: mined misses are kept on the teacher being right, and GLM is itself about 75% on multi-session, so a quarter of the added rows teach the teacher errors, amplified by duplicating each miss three times.

runs.data: 20,386 rows from 250 train-split worlds — page -> facts (real document pages must come back % nothing) and question -> plan, a quarter paraphrased by deepseek and checked; 1,013 held-out rows from dev-split worlds; max_length 4096, batch 16 x grad-accum 4
runs.notes: one model does both jobs; Datalog answers, no model API in the loop. 0% confidently wrong held out on v1 (100%) and v2 reworded documents (97.7-97.9%); invents 22-68 facts per 1000-page haystack and the page check drops every one

runs.data: 34,265 rows from 430 train-split worlds — 250 template + 120 reworded + 60 adversarial (namesakes and deferred approvals; every second reworded too) — plus real filler pages; 1,374 held-out rows from 8+4+4 dev worlds; --paraphrase 4000; max_length 4096, batch 16 x 4
runs.costNote: pod lifetime $7.21 at $4.59/h: boot, 5,261 s train, export and Q8 quantize
runs.notes: round 2 teaches the reworded prose and v3 adversarial cases the first model never saw; r1 comparison on the v3 holdout pending this bench
